items.name: MeteredJsonHandler
items.summary: Decorator over an engine-provided `Arc<dyn JsonHandler>` that emits a `JsonReadCompleted` span on every `read_json_files` call. `parse_json` and `write_json_file` are pass-through and emit nothing.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Wrap `inner`. Debug-asserts that `inner` is not already a [`MeteredJsonHandler`] so spans are emitted exactly once.

methods.name: parse_json
methods.signature: fn parse_json(&self, json_strings: Box<dyn EngineData>, output_schema: SchemaRef) -> DeltaResult<Box<dyn EngineData>>

methods.name: read_json_files
methods.signature: fn read_json_files(&self, files: &[FileMeta], physical_schema: SchemaRef, predicate: Option<PredicateRef>) -> DeltaResult<FileDataReadResultIterator>

methods.name: write_json_file
methods.signature: fn write_json_file(&self, path: &url::Url, data: DeltaResultIterator<'_, FilteredEngineData>, overwrite: bool) -> DeltaResult<()>
